name: Elicit
tagline: AI research assistant for academic papers
description: Elicit is an AI research assistant for finding and analysing academic papers, with a free Basic plan and Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans.
features: Search across more than 138 million papers
Zotero import; API access on Pro
strengths: Free Basic plan with unlimited paper summaries
Enterprise plan states no training on your data by default
limitations: Free usage of the Research Agent and Reports is limited
A separate monthly-billing price is not stated for paid plans

plans.name: Pro
highlights: Standard usage for Research Agent and Reports
Systematic review screening of up to 5,000 papers
plans.note: Monthly price not stated. The page notes 35% savings

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: Monthly price not stated. The page notes 39% savings

free.details: Basic: limited Research Agent and Research Report usage, search across 138M+ papers, unlimited paper summaries and chat with full-text papers.

pricing.regional: Currency shown only as '$'. Regional or tax note: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Basic is free; Pro $49 per user per month billed as $588 annually (save 35%); Scale $229 per user per month billed as $2,748 annually (save 39%); Enterprise custom. The Monthly toggle was not read, so monthly-billing prices remain unstated.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI research assistant for finding, screening and synthesising papers

capabilities.title: Generate research reports
capabilities.text: Briefs produced by a process inspired by systematic reviews, where you can change which papers and information they cover.

capabilities.title: Run systematic literature reviews
capabilities.text: Elicit automates screening and data extraction and partially supports search and report generation.

capabilities.title: Keep a library of sources
capabilities.text: Stores and organises sources for reuse in later projects.

capabilities.title: Stay current
capabilities.text: Routines track new research so your work does not go out of date.

featureCards.name: Elicit Research Agent
featureCards.text: Described as an AI environment built for high-stakes decisions.

featureCards.name: Sentence-level citations
featureCards.text: AI-generated claims link back to the underlying sources.

featureCards.name: Scale
featureCards.text: Finds up to 1,000 relevant papers and analyses up to 20,000 data points at once.

featureCards.name: Interactive tables
featureCards.text: Rich tables and multi-step workflows, beyond a chat window.

featureCards.name: Paper Search
featureCards.text: Listed as a solution area on the site.

featureCards.name: API and MCP
featureCards.text: Bring Elicit's capabilities into agents and workflows.

audienceDetail.text: Academia is one of the sectors named.
Both are named, with examples about new drugs and safe products.
The site cites evidence-based policy making.
The site links example reports from materials and software work.

scenarios.title: Bring a drug to patients faster
Speed up a systematic review
scenarios.text: Researchers on the site report large time savings on reviews.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Try now or Sign up button.
Elicit searches academic papers and can produce a structured report with citations.
The homepage does not answer whether Elicit is free, so look at the pricing page or talk to sales.
